title: The Argonauts Pass the Symplegades

scope.description: The Argonauts send a dove through the Symplegades and then row the Argo through safely.
scope.boundaryRationale: The paragraph contains the complete Symplegades test and successful passage.

sourceBoundaryDecision: The paragraph contains the complete Symplegades test and successful passage.

evidence.sourceText: Jason knew he was obliged to pass between these rocks or give up the expedition: so, calculating that the speed of his vessel was equal to that of a dove on the wing, he sent one out before him.
Some time during the course of their journey the Argonauts came to the Symplegades,--floating rocks which continually crashed together, and ground to powder all objects caught between them.
The Argo darted through the opening, and, when the rocks again came into contact, they merely grazed the rudder.
